wheel_start_randomization: same configured drop-height and joint-jitter distributions; same seeds
comparison: old selected policy on original XML vs final retrained policy on modified XML; old policy on modified XML is an explicit transfer check; leg best-reward checkpoint also checked if different
error_aggregation: Mean instantaneous XY error norm and absolute yaw error after first second, only before first fall. Short failed trials have no steady-state error and are judged by survival.
